_doc: Element knowledge base written by hand for Quoro. The categories follow the usual design-tool element browser (text, shapes, lines, graphics, photos, frames, charts, tables, backgrounds, audio, video). It was NOT downloaded from Canva or any plugin; nothing in it is fetched at runtime. 'role' links each kind to one of the 13 roles in roles.json, 'animation' is the entrance Quoro recommends for it.

elements.name: Heading
elements.description: Large single-line text that names the slide.
elements.whenToUse: One per slide, at the top or centre, kept under about 10 words.

elements.name: Subheading
elements.description: Smaller line that supports the heading.
elements.whenToUse: Directly under a heading to give context or a promise.

elements.name: Body text
elements.description: Paragraphs or bullet points in the main text area.
elements.whenToUse: Explanations and lists of three to six short points.

elements.name: Text box
elements.description: Free-floating text with no fill or outline.
elements.whenToUse: Captions, side notes and annotations next to other elements.

elements.name: Pull quote
elements.description: A short quotation set large, often in italics.
elements.whenToUse: Customer feedback or a memorable line; keep to one or two sentences.

elements.name: Big number
elements.description: A single large figure with a short caption.
elements.whenToUse: Headline metrics such as growth, users or revenue.

elements.name: Card
elements.description: Rounded rectangle holding a heading and a few words.
elements.whenToUse: Parallel items such as features, steps or team members; use three or four.

elements.name: Button
elements.description: Small filled shape with a short action or tag.
elements.whenToUse: Calls to action and status badges.

elements.name: Callout
elements.description: Shape with a pointer that draws attention to something.
elements.whenToUse: Pointing at a detail in a picture or chart.

elements.name: Rectangle
elements.description: Plain filled block.
elements.whenToUse: Colour blocks, bars and layout structure.

elements.name: Circle
elements.description: Round filled shape.
elements.whenToUse: Icons backgrounds, step numbers and avatars.

elements.name: Triangle
elements.description: Three-sided shape.
elements.whenToUse: Direction markers, play buttons and hierarchy diagrams.

elements.name: Star
elements.description: Star or burst shape.
elements.whenToUse: Ratings and emphasis.

elements.name: Hexagon
elements.description: Regular polygon.
elements.whenToUse: Tech themed layouts and grouped icons.

elements.name: Heart
elements.description: Heart shape.
elements.whenToUse: Likes, health and thank-you slides.

elements.name: Divider line
elements.description: Thin horizontal or vertical line.
elements.whenToUse: Separating a heading from content or two columns.

elements.name: Arrow
elements.description: Line or block arrow showing direction.
elements.whenToUse: Process flows and cause-and-effect.

elements.name: Connector
elements.description: Straight or elbow line joining two shapes.
elements.whenToUse: Org charts, diagrams and timelines.

elements.name: Timeline bar
elements.description: Long thin bar that milestones sit on.
elements.whenToUse: Roadmaps and schedules.

elements.name: Icon
elements.description: Small simple graphic that stands for an idea.
elements.whenToUse: One icon per point in a list or card; keep one icon style.

elements.name: Illustration
elements.description: Drawn artwork that carries a concept.
elements.whenToUse: Explaining abstract ideas where a photo would not work.

elements.name: Logo
elements.description: Brand mark.
elements.whenToUse: Title and closing slides; keep it small and clear of other items.

elements.name: Photo
elements.description: Photograph.
elements.whenToUse: Showing real people, places or products.

elements.name: Screenshot
elements.description: Capture of an app or website.
elements.whenToUse: Product walkthroughs; crop to the part that matters.

elements.name: Photo frame
elements.description: A shape that crops a picture, such as a circle or rounded square.
elements.whenToUse: Team portraits and image grids.

elements.name: Background photo
elements.description: Photo that fills the whole slide.
elements.whenToUse: Title and section slides; put text on a dark overlay for contrast.

elements.name: Background colour
elements.description: Full-slide colour, gradient or overlay shape.
elements.whenToUse: Setting the mood; keep contrast with text above 4.5 to 1.

elements.name: Full-width panel
elements.description: Large coloured area that carries text.
elements.whenToUse: Section dividers and big statements.

elements.name: Bar chart
elements.description: Rectangular bars sized by value.
elements.whenToUse: Comparing categories; start the axis at zero.

elements.name: Line chart
elements.description: Points joined by a line over time.
elements.whenToUse: Trends across ordered values such as dates.

elements.name: Area chart
elements.description: Line chart with the area below it filled.
elements.whenToUse: Showing volume or composition over time.

elements.name: Pie chart
elements.description: Circle divided into slices.
elements.whenToUse: Parts of one whole with up to five slices.

elements.name: Scatter chart
elements.description: Dots placed by two numeric values.
elements.whenToUse: Showing correlation or clusters.

elements.name: Table
elements.description: Rows and columns of text or numbers.
elements.whenToUse: Exact values and side-by-side comparisons; fewer than six columns.

elements.name: Footer
elements.description: Small repeating text at the bottom of the slide.
elements.whenToUse: Page numbers, dates and legal lines.

elements.name: Audio
elements.description: Sound track or voiceover. The video exporter can add looped background music (--audio) and read speaker notes aloud (--narrate); audio objects embedded in a deck are not imported.
elements.whenToUse: Background mood or spoken explanation.

elements.name: Video clip
elements.description: Embedded moving image. The exporter skips embedded video and animated GIFs.
elements.whenToUse: Demos; link to the file instead of embedding when exporting to video.

elements.name: SmartArt diagram
elements.description: PowerPoint diagram object. The exporter does not draw SmartArt; rebuild it from shapes and connectors.
elements.whenToUse: Processes, cycles and hierarchies, built from shapes if the deck will be exported.
